VUH-2569 FM-00, two-seat single-PC loopback rehearsal through real Serenity/Calling doors to Twilight Thorn. The route is recovered from VUH-2466 run20261020-002047. Both seats use pad pilots, bounded known first-hit menu0/event0 Cross dismissal during combat. No warps, synthetic kills, HP/team writes, immunity, or save. Strict mission/RC/damage/victory assertions intentionally fail unfinished synchronization. Final captioned evidence requires native315 encoding qualification and final video assembly; 30s blocks include encoder gaps. Both combat pilots approach at reach300; owner1 completion remains mandatory without a distant-host bias. Both combat pilots integrate peer revival into their own pad loop; each becomes neutral while logically downed and approaches a lone downed peer for the native1600ms Triangle hold only when nativeRC0. Natural downings must recover; none are forced. Bossdoor hands off on the real room crossing, without waiting for event=false. Combat pilots handle only named native camera RCs297/298/299 under the initial room scope; the first raw two-screen block supplies ingress pixels, avoiding separate capture delays before opening reactions. Both Thorn fight steps explicitly use lowHp0 so25% native revive returns can resume ordinary attacks. At most three bounded jump/two-Cross probes address a reproduced short approach stall; actual hit claims must show any benefit. Live08 keeps both pilot routes, reach, timing and strategy unchanged. Its input observation uses the fresh product-qualified actionable reaction from existing read-only version7 prompt fields; raw cached RC remains diagnostic. No new network fields or synthetic control are introduced. The scenario owns combat recordings; its two combat pilots skip their best-effort failure screenshot/clip to avoid competing for the same capture channel. Gameplay and failure status are unchanged. VUH-2617 separate run_thorn.py/thorn.py pilots; original product assertions and twelve paired blocks are retained. After exact two-driver successful reap/release, try sequential 400ms native pad onward pulses; direction and safe movement are not qualified in advance and any changed scope or insufficient movement fails.

Early door handoff avoids waiting through camera reactions, but native admission reads and pilot startup still take time; review the opening offer/completion receipts before claiming every opening window was exercised.
